title: Approved Pharmaceutical Products
description: Complete list of pharmaceutical products approved by the Drug Control Authority. The table provides a preview of the dataset using 10 records as a sample.

fields.name: reg_no
fields.title: Registration Number
fields.description: [String] Unique identifier for the product's registration

fields.name: ref_no
fields.title: Reference Number
fields.description: [String] Reference number for official checking purposes

fields.name: holder
fields.title: Holder
fields.description: [String] Company or entity holding the registration

fields.name: holder_osa
fields.title: Holder OSA Code
fields.description: [String] Unique identifier for the product license holder

fields.name: manufacturer
fields.title: Manufacturer
fields.description: [String] Name of the manufacturer of the product

fields.name: importer
fields.title: Importer
fields.description: [String] Company responsible for importing the product

fields.name: date_reg
fields.title: Registration Date
fields.description: [Date] Date when the product was registered in YYYY-MM-DD format

fields.name: date_end
fields.title: Expiry Date
fields.description: [Date] Date when the product's registration expires in YYYY-MM-DD format

fields.name: active_ingredient
fields.title: Active Ingredient(s)
fields.description: [String] List of active ingredients in the product, including quantities

fields.name: mdc_code
fields.title: MDC Code
fields.description: [String] Code indicating the medical device classification

fields.name: generic_name
fields.title: Generic Name
fields.description: [String] Generic name of the product or its active ingredients

methodology: In accordance with the Control of Drugs and Cosmetics Regulations 1984, all pharmaceutical, health and personal care products marketed in Malaysia must be registered and approved by the Drug Control Authority (DCA). In the present day, registrations are conducted using the QUEST3+ system, which is the administrative system used by NPRA to enable the online management of product registrations, variations, licensing, market sampling, renewal and others. This dataset is an exact copy of the administrative record of approved products, with any columns containing personal data excluded.
caveat: Although this data represents administrative records, it nevertheless remains a static dataset which is updated once per day, rather than in real time. As such, this dataset should not be used as the basis for any legal action. Any queries on enforcement of the relevant laws of Malaysia should always be referred to the National Pharmaceutical Regulatory Agency (NPRA).
